comment: Labelled recall corpus for the Rhino API discovery ranker (PRD §09 success criterion: Revit's TestRealCorpusRecall equivalent over a labelled Rhino query set, both languages). Each case is a task sentence and the ONE member that best answers it, expressed as a Type.Member (or rhinoscriptsyntax.Name) suffix of the member's declaring-type + name. `language` records which script language the task is phrased for -- python tasks expect a rhinoscriptsyntax function, csharp tasks a RhinoCommon member -- so recall is reported per language too. This is a labelled set, NOT a hit list: cases that MISS are kept (a corpus tuned to 100%% recall is cherry-picked and measures nothing), exactly as Revit's TestRealCorpusRecall keeps its misses. Measured live against Rhino 8.35 by TestDiscoveryRecallCorpus: recall @1=10/24 (0.42), @3=16/24 (0.67), @10=23/24 (0.96); csharp @1=7/12 @3=9/12 @10=12/12, python @1=3/12 @3=7/12 @10=11/12. The test's floors sit below these to catch a broken ranker/port, not to pin any single query.
